review_surfaces: Final contact sheet at original resolution, including both 60 px Home Screen rows

content_review.in_icon_text_or_numerals: none; clocks use ticks; S-shaped steam and X stitches are drawn object forms
content_review.blood_or_gore: none; hearts are abstract padded shapes
content_review.brands_or_trademarked_medical_symbols: none; R2-22 has a generic teal plus
content_review.canvas: opaque square; rounded corners only in the contact-sheet Home Screen simulations

picks.reason: The close crop makes the actual counter, computer, blue cooler and rear-wall clock most visible at 60 px.
A broad teal ring, coral hands and gold cross stitches give a simple recognizable time-and-stitch mark.
Coral against teal and three broad cream cross stitches remain clear at Home Screen size.
The brass frame, coral sand and teal thread keep the warm and cool materials distinct at 60 px.
The teal diner mug, gold-rim clock and cream steam read quickly against deep green.

notes: Whole-room versions show the clinic layout and color; close room crops prioritize the counter and clock.
Small props such as the phone and needle are secondary to the large subject silhouette.
Object exports use a 128 px grid to preserve stitch shapes; adaptive color reduction preserves warm and blue/teal accents.
R2-13 was edited a second time to correct its main body from teal to clinic green.
scope: Concept art only; no app integration.
